battle.name: 愛沙尼亞解放戰爭
battle.brief: 愛沙尼亞解放戰爭始於一九一七年十一月，愛沙尼亞軍隊與德國占領當局及後來進入的蘇俄部隊在愛沙尼亞境內作戰，戰線亦延伸至鄰近海域與島嶼。英國海軍 Steam ironclad 蒸汽鐵甲艦是當年已列裝的海軍裝備，呈現蒸汽動力裝甲艦的時代背景。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: Steam ironclad 蒸汽鐵甲艦在英國海軍體系中屬蒸汽動力裝甲艦種，憑藉重武裝與裝甲防護擔任艦隊警戒、海上封鎖及沿岸防衛。

countries: 愛沙尼亞戰線的陣營並非自始固定。1917年，愛沙尼亞委員會與愛沙尼亞臨時政府依賴愛沙尼亞步兵團、地方守軍及鐵路防衛部隊，對抗仍效忠俄羅斯帝國的軍隊，以及同年11月後掌握彼得格勒與莫斯科的蘇維埃政權。1918年2月，德意志帝國第八軍所屬的阿爾布支隊進入愛沙尼亞，驅逐布爾什維克部隊並控制主要鐵路；同年3月德方公開承認愛沙尼亞獨立，卻同時把臨時政府的活動置於軍事佔領之下。蘇維埃俄羅斯及其紅軍是1918年至1920年最主要的地面敵手。芬蘭白軍以志願營形式支援愛沙尼亞，拉脫維亞尚未建國前的拉脫維亞步槍兵則與愛沙尼亞部隊協同防守采西斯及納爾瓦方向。英國、法國等協約國並未投入決定戰場的大批地面部隊，但在外交承認、武器供應與海上補給方面具有影響。
countriesEn: The alignment on the Estonian front changed repeatedly. In 1917, the Estonian Committee and the Provisional Government relied on Estonian infantry regiments, local garrison units, and railway-defense detachments to oppose troops still loyal to the Russian Empire and, after November, the Bolshevik government controlling Petrograd and Moscow. In February 1918, elements of the German Eighth Army under Detachment Alb entered Estonia, drove out the Bolshevik forces, and secured the principal railways. In March, Germany publicly recognized Estonian independence while placing the Provisional Government’s work under military occupation. Soviet Russia and the Red Army were the principal land adversaries from 1918 through 1920. White Finnish volunteers supported Estonia in battalion formations, while the Latvian Riflemen, operating before Latvia became a state, cooperated with Estonian troops in the Cēsis and Narva sectors. Britain, France, and other Allied governments did not commit major ground forces to the battlefield, but they influenced diplomatic recognition, arms supply, and maritime support.
people: 康斯坦丁·佩茨、雅安·滕尼松與後來出任國家元首的雅安·蘇茨，構成愛沙尼亞的政治領導核心；賈諾納斯·萊多納爾則由參謀工作逐步掌握陸軍指揮，1918年11月德軍撤離後成為陸軍總司令。1917年7月，第一與第五愛沙尼亞步槍團在彼得格勒成立，同年底又組建第六步槍團，這些部隊在革命浪潮中轉向本國陣營。1919年的采西斯戰役中，拉脫維亞步槍兵指揮官卡爾里斯·扎里ņš與愛沙尼亞步兵、炮兵共同作戰；1920年佩特瑟里方向作戰的芬蘭志願兵則由馬爾蒂·瓦萊恩率領。各作戰階段還可見波羅的海艦隊水兵、塔林碼頭守軍、鐵路警衛、工程、通信、衛生及後勤人員。蘇軍主要以第二、第三、第九及第十一師等師級部隊投入，拉脫維亞與芬蘭方向因有可靠盟友協同，愛沙尼亞才得以集中兵力封鎖道路與城鎮。
peopleEn: Konstantin Päts, Jaan Tõnisson, and the future head of state Jaan Soots formed the core of Estonia’s political leadership. Joonas Laidoner advanced from staff work to command the army and became commander in chief after the German withdrawal in November 1918. The 1st and 5th Estonian Infantry Regiments were formed in Petrograd in July 1917, and the 6th was established later that year; all shifted allegiance during the revolutionary upheavals. At Cēsis in 1919, the Latvian Riflemen under Kārlis Zariņš fought alongside Estonian infantry and artillery. Martti Wallén commanded the Finnish volunteers fighting toward Petseri in 1920. Baltic Fleet sailors, Tallinn harbor guards, railway security detachments, engineers, signallers, medical personnel, and logistics units also appear throughout the campaign. Soviet forces primarily committed the 2nd, 3rd, 9th, and 11th Divisions. Reliable Latvian and Finnish cooperation allowed Estonia to concentrate troops against the roads and towns leading toward Pärnu, Valga, Cēsis, and Narva.
kits: 步兵作戰的核心是莫辛-納甘M1891步槍，彈藥為7.62×54毫米R，配五發可拆彈匣；部分愛沙尼亞與蘇軍單位使用毛瑟Gewehr 88 M1888步槍，7.92×57毫米R彈藥與前者的供應鏈不能混用。機槍火力包括蘇制Maxim M1910配索科洛夫輪式座架，以及1918年後由英國交付愛沙尼亞、1911年已列裝的Vickers機槍。炮兵主要使用76.2公厘師屬砲與團屬砲M1902，並可見107公厘迫擊砲M1910及152公厘榴彈砲M1910。德軍在佔領區及東線部署7.7公分FK 96野戰砲、10.5公分leFH 16榴彈砲、Gewehr 98k步槍及MG 08/15輕機槍。步槍彈以五發一匣分裝，機槍彈由彈鏈及彈箱供應，各種口徑分庫保管；炮彈則由鐵路樞紐送至後方軍械庫，再以馬車分送前線射擊陣位。冬季裝備、牽引馬匹、鐵鏟、鍬、野外電話及雪橇構成持續作戰所需的實際後勤負擔。
kitsEn: The infantry relied chiefly on the Mosin-Nagant M1891 rifle firing 7.62×54mmR ammunition from five-round detachable magazines. Some Estonian and Soviet units also used the Gewehr 88 M1888 rifle in 7.92×57mmR, a caliber that could not share the same ammunition chain. Machine-gun strength included the Soviet Maxim M1910 on its Sokolov wheeled carriage and British Vickers machine guns delivered to Estonia after 1918; the Vickers type had entered British service in 1911. The artillery inventory centered on the 76.2mm divisional and regimental guns M1902, with the 107mm mortar M1910 and 152mm howitzer M1910 also available. German forces in the occupied territory and on the eastern front fielded the 7.7cm FK 96 field gun, 10.5cm leFH 16 howitzer, Gewehr 98k rifle, and MG 08/15 light machine gun. Rifle ammunition was issued in five-round clips, machine-gun ammunition came in belts and boxes, and calibers were kept in separate stores. Artillery ammunition moved from railhead depots to firing positions by horse cart. Winter clothing, draught horses, picks, shovels, field telephones, and sleds formed the practical burden required to sustain operations.
tactics: 1917年的首要戰術是解除武裝和奪取要害，而不是正面消耗。第5愛沙尼亞步槍團及碼頭守軍在塔林繳收武器、封閉兵營與車站，迅速壓低赤衛兵的抵抗能力；鐵路沿線則以守備班、巡邏隊和預警崗位維持城鎮間聯絡。1918年1月，紅軍由佩爾努向辛迪、瓦爾加及佩爾努-雅阿古皮方向推進時，愛沙尼亞守軍避免在缺乏重炮與補充縱深的情況下固守每一城鎮，改以道路阻滯、橋梁破壞和後方陣地換取時間；德軍到來後，進攻重心轉向鐵路樞紐控制。1919年重建的愛沙尼亞軍採師級防禦，步兵依托塹壕、機槍火力封鎖道路彎道，炮兵集中射擊道路與居民點之外的可辨識目標，預備隊在縱深待命而非逐線投入。反擊采西斯與納爾瓦時，步兵依鐵路和道路集結，由炮兵先期測量，輕裝分隊掩護側翼，再以連續陣地形成攻勢；前線後勤仍受制於塔爾圖、佩爾努等鐵路節點與馬車運力。塔林灣的巡邏、佈雷與海岸砲火則配合陸路封鎖。
tacticsEn: The first tactical objective in 1917 was disarmament and the seizure of vital points rather than costly frontal combat. The 5th Estonian Infantry Regiment and harbor guards collected weapons in Tallinn, closed barracks and stations, and quickly reduced the Red Guards’ ability to resist. Along the railways, guard platoons, patrols, and warning posts maintained contact between towns. When the Red Army advanced from Pärnu toward Sindi, Valga, and Pärnu-Jaagupi in January 1918, the Estonian garrison avoided trying to hold every settlement without heavy artillery or replacement depth. It used road delays, damaged bridges, and prepared rear positions to gain time until German troops shifted the struggle toward control of the rail junctions. The reconstituted Estonian army of 1919 fought at divisional scale: infantry relied on trenches, machine guns covering road bends, and artillery concentrated against targets identifiable outside the defended settlements, while reserves waited in depth instead of being committed line by line. During the counterattacks toward Cēsis and Narva, troops converged along roads and railways, artillery conducted preliminary ranging, lightly equipped formations protected the flanks, and infantry formed successive positions for the attack. Logistics remained constrained by railheads at Tartu and Pärnu and by horse-cart delivery. Patrols, minefields, and coastal gunfire in the Gulf of Finland supported the land blockade.
data: 戰爭通常以1917年2月28日為起點：彼得格勒革命切斷俄羅斯帝國原有指揮鏈，愛沙尼亞士兵開始在軍隊內建立本國組織。1917年7月，第一與第五愛沙尼亞步槍團在彼得格勒組成；11月形成第六步槍團，愛沙尼亞委員會則於11月15日公布政治綱領，19日把權力交給康斯坦丁·佩茨主持的臨時政府。11月底，赤衛兵及部分波羅的海艦隊水兵在塔林奪取軍用要害，第五步槍團與其他守軍解除其武裝，臨時政府重新控制塔林。1918年1月23日至24日，蘇軍由海陸方向進入佩爾努並占領市區，部隊沿佩爾努至雅阿古皮的海岸線及辛迪、瓦爾加方向展開；守軍退守縱深，瓦爾加前線逐漸成形。2月，德軍阿爾布支隊越境，消滅該區布爾什維克部隊並控制佩爾努、瓦爾加與通往塔爾圖的鐵路。3月3日俄羅斯與中央 Powers 簽訂布列斯特-立陶夫斯克條約，3月7日德方公開承認愛沙尼亞獨立，愛沙尼亞政府的實際運作從此受限於德軍佔領。第一與第五愛沙尼亞步槍團其後被納入德軍序列，在德羅涅與第聶伯方向作戰；芬蘭白軍第一志願營亦加入佩爾努方面。1918年11月德軍撤出後，愛沙尼亞臨時政府恢復，萊多納爾整編步兵、炮兵、工程、通信及後勤分隊，建立師級指揮體系。1919年1月，蘇軍第二與第三師再次沿瓦爾加和佩爾努方向進攻；1月23日前後，拉脫維亞步槍兵與愛沙尼亞部隊在采西斯正面阻擋蘇軍，芬蘭志願營及愛沙尼亞守軍則在佩爾努外圍把紅軍阻於接近城市的距離，迫使蘇軍於2月初退離主要陣地。4月對薩愛馬島的蘇軍登陸嘗試也被擊退。5月上旬，愛軍與拉脫維亞步槍兵反擊並進入采西斯，但聯軍沒有把戰線長期推向俄境；5月底至6月初，愛軍又在納爾瓦方向渡河攻擊，未能長期控制伊萬哥羅德。1920年1月28日，蘇軍沿瓦爾加至佩特瑟里方向再攻，1月31日達成停戰安排，2月2日簽訂《塔爾圖條約》。條約生效前後，塔爾圖俄軍駐軍與波羅的海艦隊水兵仍發動軍事起義，愛軍在3月初解除起義武裝；芬蘭志願兵由馬爾蒂·瓦萊恩率領，在佩特瑟里方向延續戰鬥，但沒有改變條約確定的邊界。
dataEn: The war is conventionally dated from 28 February 1917, when the revolution in Petrograd disrupted the Russian Empire’s chain of command and Estonian soldiers began organizing national formations within the armed forces. The 1st and 5th Estonian Infantry Regiments were formed in Petrograd in July 1917, followed by the 6th in November. The Estonian Committee published its political program on 15 November and transferred authority to the Provisional Government headed by Konstantin Päts on the nineteenth. Late that month, Red Guards and elements of the Baltic Fleet seized military positions in Tallinn; the 5th Regiment and other guards disarmed them, restoring government control. On 23–24 January 1918, Soviet troops entered Pärnu by land and sea, occupied the town, and advanced along the coast toward Pärnu-Jaagupi and through Sindi toward Valga. The defenders withdrew into depth as the Valga front formed. In February, Detachment Alb crossed the border, defeated the Bolshevik forces in the area, and secured Pärnu, Valga, and the railway toward Tartu. After the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk on 3 March, Germany publicly recognized Estonian independence on 7 March, but actual government operations were constrained by military occupation. The 1st and 5th Estonian Regiments were subsequently incorporated into German formations and fought on the Dvina and Dnieper fronts; the First Finnish Volunteer Battalion also joined the Pärnu sector. Following the German withdrawal in November 1918, the Provisional Government returned, and Laidoner reorganized infantry, artillery, engineers, signals, and logistics into a divisional command structure. In January 1919, the Soviet 2nd and 3rd Divisions advanced again toward Valga and Pärnu. Around 23 January, the Latvian Riflemen and Estonian troops checked the Soviets near Cēsis, while Finnish volunteers and Estonian defenders held the Red Army close to Pärnu, forcing a withdrawal from the principal positions by early February. A Soviet landing attempt on Saaremaa in April was also defeated. In early May, Estonian and Latvian forces counterattacked and entered Cēsis, but the allies did not extend the front deeply into Russian territory. From late May into early June, Estonian forces crossed the Narva River in another attack but did not retain Ivangorod. On 28 January 1920, Soviet forces advanced again along the Valga–Petseri axis. A ceasefire arrangement followed on 31 January, and the Treaty of Tartu was signed on 2 February. Around the treaty’s implementation, the Russian garrison at Tartu and Baltic Fleet sailors launched a military revolt; Estonian forces disarmed them by early March. Finnish volunteers led by Martti Wallén continued the struggle toward Petseri without altering the border fixed by the treaty.
cause: 解放戰爭的直接原因，是第一次世界大戰末期俄羅斯帝國的軍政崩解使愛沙尼亞土地上的權力真空迅速暴露。長期實施的俄化政策、俄語行政與少數民族徵兵制度，使愛沙尼亞的政治組織與帝國軍隊中的愛沙尼亞士兵之間出現難以調和的衝突。1917年革命後，布爾什維克、德意志帝國、白俄勢力與愛沙尼亞民族力量都試圖控制塔林、佩爾努、塔爾圖、瓦爾加及納爾瓦，而這些城鎮和鐵路節點決定了全境軍力能否集中。愛沙尼亞方面必須先取得國家行政與軍隊指揮權，再建立由本國軍官和士兵執行的防線，因此解除原俄軍武裝、奪取鐵路、對抗赤衛兵及擊退德軍佔領構成了連續而具體的軍事原因。蘇維埃俄羅斯則希望維持革命政權在舊俄帝國西部的權力，並阻止愛沙尼亞建立武裝國家。戰爭並非單一政令引發，而是在革命、軍隊叛離、鄰國干預與地方軍力競逐交會時形成。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Liberation War was the rapid exposure of a power vacuum in Estonia as the military and political structure of the Russian Empire disintegrated during the final phase of the First World War. Russification policies, Russian-language administration, and the conscription of non-Russian populations into imperial units created an irreconcilable conflict between Estonia’s political organizations and the Estonian soldiers serving in the imperial army. After the 1917 revolution, Bolsheviks, the German Empire, White Russian forces, and Estonian national organizations all sought control of Tallinn, Pärnu, Tartu, Valga, and Narva. These towns and railway junctions determined whether military power could be concentrated across the country. Estonia first needed to secure governmental authority and operational command, then construct a front commanded by its own officers and soldiers. Disarming former Russian units, securing the railways, defeating the Red Guards, and removing German occupation therefore formed a continuous sequence of concrete military objectives. Soviet Russia sought to preserve Bolshevik authority in the western former empire and prevent the establishment of an armed Estonian state. The war arose not from a single decree but from the intersection of revolution, military mutiny, foreign intervention, and rivalry among locally organized armed forces.
impact: 軍事上，愛沙尼亞由1917年的團級起義與臨時守備單位，發展為能獨立運用步兵、炮兵、機槍、工兵、通信、衛生、海軍及海岸警戒力量的常備軍。到1919年末，陸軍已建立多個步兵師，炮兵能以集中射擊支援師級攻勢，後勤則以波羅的海鐵路、塔爾圖與佩爾努軍械庫、馬車運輸及冬季雪橇銜接。采西斯與納爾瓦方向的失利，使紅軍重新檢視西北戰線的進攻縱深、側翼保障和補給；愛沙尼亞則獲得把防禦轉為有限反攻的經驗。外交上，芬蘭於1919年底正式承認愛沙尼亞，協約國主要國家隨後也承認其獨立地位，使塔爾圖條約具備較穩定的國際前提。各階段的傷亡數字在當時命令、陣亡登記與後來研究中口徑不同，不能負責任地合併成單一精確總數，因此較可靠的結論是雙方在反攻與城市攻防中均承受大量傷亡，而戰局轉折主要由兵力部署、砲火準備與補給條件決定。
impactEn: Militarily, Estonia developed from the mutinous regiments and temporary guards of 1917 into a standing army capable of employing infantry, artillery, machine guns, engineers, signals, medical units, a navy, and coastal security independently. By the end of 1919, the army possessed several infantry divisions; artillery could support divisional attacks with concentrated fire, while logistics joined the Baltic Railway, depots at Tartu and Pärnu, horse-cart transport, and winter sleds. Soviet defeats around Cēsis and Narva forced the Red Army to reassess operational depth, flank security, and supply on the northwestern front. Estonia, in turn, gained the experience required to convert a defensive front into limited counteroffensives. Diplomatically, Finland formally recognized Estonia at the end of 1919, and the principal Allied governments subsequently followed, giving the Treaty of Tartu a more secure international setting. Contemporary orders, casualty registers, and later studies used inconsistent categories for losses, so no single precise total can responsibly be combined. The defensible conclusion is that both sides suffered substantial casualties during the counteroffensives and urban fighting, while the turning points were determined chiefly by troop disposition, artillery preparation, and supply conditions.
result: 1917年是愛沙尼亞解放戰爭的起點，而不是軍事與法律上的終點。1920年2月2日，愛沙尼亞與蘇維埃俄羅斯簽訂《塔爾圖條約》；蘇方正式承認愛沙尼亞獨立及愛沙尼亞的國家地位，愛方則放棄對現行愛沙尼亞東部邊界以外地區的要求。條約把佩特瑟里與伊萬哥羅德留給蘇維埃俄羅斯，納爾瓦河則成為多數地段上的分界，佩爾努、塔爾圖及其他重要據點仍掌握在愛沙尼亞手中。蘇軍未能占領愛沙尼亞全境，愛沙尼亞的反攻雖曾越過納爾瓦河，卻也沒有轉變為推翻蘇維埃政權的全面戰爭。軍事結果因此是愛沙尼亞保住國家與主要交通線，而蘇維埃俄羅斯保住佩特瑟里等戰略要地。停戰後塔爾圖的軍事起義與佩特瑟里方向的零星戰鬥持續至1920年3月，但沒有推翻條約成果。從1917年第一與第五愛沙尼亞步槍團的組建，到愛沙尼亞陸軍、總參謀系統與外交機構的成熟，這段歷程使一支由帝國軍隊中的愛沙尼亞士兵發展而來的武裝，完成為獨立國建立持續防衛與區域作戰能力的轉變。
resultEn: The year 1917 marks the beginning of the Estonian War of Independence, not its military or legal conclusion. On 2 February 1920, Estonia and Soviet Russia signed the Treaty of Tartu. The Soviet side formally recognized Estonia’s independence and statehood, while Estonia renounced its claims to territories beyond the eastern border that became the international frontier. The treaty left Petseri and Ivangorod in Soviet Russia and used the Narva River as the boundary along most of its length; Pärnu, Tartu, and the other principal centers remained in Estonian hands. The Red Army failed to occupy Estonia as a whole. Estonian counteroffensives crossed the Narva River, but they did not develop into a general war aimed at overthrowing the Soviet government. The military result was therefore an Estonia secure in its state and principal lines of communication, alongside a Soviet Russia that retained strategically important places such as Petseri. The military revolt at Tartu and scattered fighting in the Petseri sector continued into March 1920, but neither altered the treaty’s settlement. From the organization of the 1st and 5th Estonian Regiments in 1917 to the maturation of the Estonian army, general staff, and diplomatic institutions, this process transformed armed Estonian soldiers within an imperial army into a force capable of sustaining the defense and regional operations of an independent state.
